EmailTemplate.subject: Periodic Review Is Now Overdue – Reminder 2
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Periodic Review Is Now Overdue – Reminder 2
Dear {!Contact.FirstName} {!Contact.LastName},
Thank you for being part of the ila family,
To further enhance your banking experience with us and as per instructions from the Central Bank of Bahrain, we are required to complete a review of the information we have on our customers periodically.
As we informed you via email on {!Case.Periodic_Review_Sent_Date__c},your account was due for review on {!Case.Periodic_Review_Date_On_Email_Template__c}.
IMPORTANT: We can update your information using the services offered by the Benefit Company if you give your consent to us to access your information with iGA. You can use our app to provide your consent.
You can instead visit our Service Center at Diplomatic Area during office hours to submit the following documents so that we can update your profile.
{!IF(Case.pr_WathiqConsentAcceptanceRequired__c= true, "Bahraini CPR Copy ", null)} {!IF(Case.pr_WathiqConsentFormRequired__c= true, "Bahraini CPR Copy ", null)} {!IF(Case.pr_PassportPhotoRequired__c = true, "Passport Copy Required ", null)} {!IF(Case.pr_ResidencyPermitPhotoRequired__c = true, "Residency Permit (RP) Copy Required ", null)} {!IF(Case.pr_OtherDocumentsRequired__c = true, Case.Other_Documents_Required_Description__c, null)}
To ease the process and make this effortless for you, please arrange to provide your consent before the {!Case.Periodic_Review_Date_On_Email_Template__c}.
Our Support team will be happy to serve you 7 days a week, 24 hours a day on +973 17123456 , or you can send us an email to support@ilabank.com
Open ila app
Bank ABC Tower, Head Office, P.O Box: 5698, Manama, Kingdom of Bahrain
This email and any files transmitted with it are confidential and intended solely for the use of the individual or entity to whom they are addressed. If you have received this email in error, please notify the system manager.
Licensed as a Conventional Retail Bank – Branch by the Central Bank of Bahrain
